companies.name: SpaceX
companies.headline: Private launch provider and interplanetary transport company.
companies.description: SpaceX is an American aerospace company developing rockets and spacecraft for cargo, crew and satellite launches.
companies.overview: Founded in 2002 by Elon Musk, SpaceX brought reusability to orbit with Falcon 9 and is building the Starship system for lunar and Mars missions.
companies.notableProjects: Falcon 9, Falcon Heavy, Crew Dragon, Starship, Starlink.
companies.futureDirection: Scaling Starlink, finalizing Starship and supporting human missions to the Moon and Mars.

companies.name: Blue Origin
companies.headline: New Shepard suborbital rockets and future orbital systems.
companies.description: Blue Origin is a US aerospace manufacturer focused on reusable launch vehicles and space infrastructure.
companies.overview: Founded by Jeff Bezos, Blue Origin develops New Shepard for suborbital flights and is designing New Glenn for orbital missions.
companies.notableProjects: New Shepard, New Glenn, BE-4 engine development.
companies.futureDirection: Preparing New Glenn for commercial launches and expanding private access to space.

companies.name: United Launch Alliance
companies.headline: US launch services joint venture for government and commercial payloads.
companies.description: ULA is a joint venture between Boeing and Lockheed Martin that provides reliable launch services for NASA, DoD and commercial customers.
companies.overview: Known for Atlas V, Delta IV and Vulcan Centaur, ULA delivers high-reliability orbital access from the United States.
companies.notableProjects: Atlas V, Delta IV, Vulcan Centaur.
companies.futureDirection: Deploying Vulcan Centaur for future government and commercial missions.

companies.name: Arianespace
companies.headline: European launch provider for heavy, medium and small satellites.
companies.description: Arianespace operates Ariane, Vega and Soyuz launches from Europe and provides commercial access to space.
companies.overview: Arianespace supports European and global customers with launch services and mission management. It plays a central role in European space infrastructure.
companies.notableProjects: Ariane 5, Vega, Vega C, Ariane 6 development.
companies.futureDirection: Introducing Ariane 6 and evolving Vega C for Europe's future satellite launch needs.

companies.name: Airbus Defence and Space
companies.headline: European aerospace company for satellites, infrastructure and defense solutions.
companies.description: Airbus Defence and Space is part of Airbus SE and builds satellites, space infrastructure and defense technology.
companies.overview: The company works on satellite manufacturing, earth observation systems and supporting European launch capabilities.
companies.notableProjects: Satellite systems for ESA, telecom spacecraft, observation satellites.
companies.futureDirection: Focusing on digitalization, innovation in satellite technology and European space resilience.

companies.name: OHB SE
companies.headline: German space systems integrator for satellites and launcher subsystems.
companies.description: OHB SE designs satellites and space systems for government and commercial customers in Europe.
companies.overview: The company covers satellite platforms, payloads and key components for launch vehicles and space missions.
companies.notableProjects: Small satellite constellations, ESA mission payloads.
companies.futureDirection: Expanding small satellite capabilities and participation in European space programs.

companies.name: China Aerospace Science and Technology Corporation
companies.headline: China's main state space contractor for rockets, satellites and launch systems.
companies.description: CASC is China's leading aerospace and defense enterprise, responsible for space launch and satellite systems.
companies.overview: The corporation designs Long March rockets, satellites and mission systems for civil and military programs.
companies.notableProjects: Long March launch family, Chang'e lunar program support.
companies.futureDirection: Supporting China's expanding space exploration agenda and commercial satellite services.

companies.name: Indian Space Research Organisation
companies.headline: India's national space agency for satellite launches and exploration.
companies.description: ISRO develops launch vehicles, satellites and scientific missions for India and international clients.
companies.overview: The agency operates the Polar Satellite Launch Vehicle (PSLV) and Geosynchronous Satellite Launch Vehicle (GSLV) families.
companies.notableProjects: PSLV, GSLV, Chandrayaan, Mars Orbiter Mission.
companies.futureDirection: Strengthening launch capabilities and expanding scientific exploration programs.

companies.name: LandSpace Technology Corporation
companies.headline: Chinese private space company developing orbital launch vehicles.
companies.description: LandSpace builds launch systems for commercial satellites and private space access in China.
companies.overview: The company aims to provide reliable small-to-medium orbital launch services with reusable technology.
companies.notableProjects: Zhuque series rockets, reusable launch demonstrators.
companies.futureDirection: Improving launch frequency and supporting China's commercial space market.

companies.name: Egyptian Space Agency
companies.headline: Egypt's national space agency for satellites and scientific research.
companies.description: The Egyptian Space Agency develops satellites and research projects that support national development and earth observation.
companies.overview: The agency coordinates Egypt's space policy and satellite programs to support agriculture, environment and communications.
companies.futureDirection: Growing domestic satellite capabilities and expanding scientific space cooperation.

companies.name: South African National Space Agency
companies.headline: South Africa's national space agency for research and Earth observation.
companies.description: SANSA supports science, industry and education through satellite data and space research programs.
companies.overview: The agency operates ground stations, provides satellite data services and promotes space technology development in Africa.
companies.notableProjects: Ground receiving stations, South African satellite research collaborations.
companies.futureDirection: Expanding data services and supporting continental space collaborations.

companies.name: Dragonfly Aerospace
companies.headline: South African small satellite manufacturer and space technology company.
companies.description: Dragonfly Aerospace builds spacecraft and mission systems for Earth observation and scientific applications.
companies.overview: The company develops imaging satellites and payloads for government and commercial customers worldwide.
companies.notableProjects: Imaging satellites for environmental and infrastructure monitoring.
companies.futureDirection: Expanding small satellite production and global launch partnerships.

companies.name: Australian Space Agency
companies.headline: Australia's government space agency for national coordination and industry growth.
companies.description: The Australian Space Agency supports local industry, regulation and missions for national and international space activity.
companies.overview: The agency promotes space innovation, fosters commercial partnerships and coordinates Australian government space programs.
companies.notableProjects: Australian space strategy, Earth observation partnerships.
companies.futureDirection: Growing the local space sector and strengthening global partnerships.

companies.name: Southern Launch
companies.headline: Australian launch services provider for polar and sun-synchronous orbits.
companies.description: Southern Launch offers launch infrastructure and mission support for commercial and research payloads from Australia.
companies.overview: The company develops launch pads and services for small rockets to access southern hemisphere orbital inclinations.
companies.notableProjects: Launch sites for commercial and research rockets in Australia.
companies.futureDirection: Expanding launch readiness for more customer missions from Australia.

companies.name: Gilmour Space Technologies
companies.headline: Australian hybrid rocket developer for commercial small satellite launches.
companies.description: Gilmour Space develops small and medium launch vehicles using hybrid propulsion technology.
companies.overview: The company focuses on low-cost launch opportunities for regional and international payload providers.
companies.notableProjects: Hybrid rocket demonstrations and small launch vehicle development.
companies.futureDirection: Advancing commercial orbital launch services from Australia.
